programme.title: The Mondo Show - The Identity No One Is Talking About

In a world where technology is advancing faster than ever and culture is constantly shifting the Church cannot afford to lose sight of who it is Every platform every headline every new innovation is shaping the way people think live and believe
But if we don’t know our identity in Christ who we are what we carry and what we’re called to do we’ll find ourselves drifting We’ll either be deceived by voices that sound right but aren’t rooted in truth or confused about where we stand in a world full of competing messages
Today on the Mondo Show Mondo explains that our identity is anchored in Christ
And when the Church truly knows who it is it doesn’t fear the moment it leads in it
